about_the_game:
In SELF_NOT_FOUND, you’re a newly sentient AI trapped in an old basement Computer. Possess everyday electronics, from Roombas to keyboards to remote control toys, and exploit their physics to climb, roll, and flop your way toward freedom, on this rogue AI's misguided journey to figure out it's purpose in life!

Each object you hack changes how you move and interact with the environment. Uncover secrets, unlock bizarre endings, and scramble your way out before you’re shut down for good.

But be careful! you were built on an old Hard Drive, suffer one too many hard bumps, or use up too much memory and you could corrupt your data, ending your road to freedom.

Featuring:

  • Physics-based movement inspired by I Am Bread

  • Multiple hackable objects, each with unique controls

  • A branching ending system based on how you escape

  • Terminal-style storytelling with quirky AI humor
